description.p: NOMM is a stupid simple, super clean "native" (as in it runs on Linux without having to use translation tools...) mod manager for Linux. The goal here is to keep the setup really simple for users like me who don't need the super advanced/complex features. Just a few clicks on a clean, modern interface, and you're done :)
Don't expect NOMM to manage mods for something like Skyrim. There are specific tools for that (see NaK or Jackify).
Instead, think of NOMM as more of a general purpose tool for most games that just need you to point to a directory and extract some mod archives.

ul.li: NOMM can now be properly launched even when no Steam installation is present on user system
